Our task is to find A, B, and C such that −2x2+19x+30(x−2)(x+1)(3x+4)=Ax−2+Bx+1+C3x+4.

Multiplying both sides by (x−2)(x+1)(3x+4) gives

−2x2+19x+30=A(x+1)(3x+4)+B(x−2)(3x+4)+C(x−2)(x+1).

For x=2, we get −2(2)2+19(2)+30=A(2+1)(3(2)+4)+B(2−2)(3(2)+4)+C(2−2)(2+1)60=30AA=2.

For x=−1, we get −2(−1)2+19(−1)+30=A(−1+1)(3(−1)+4)+B(−1−2)(3(−1)+4)+C(−1−2)(−1+1)9=−3BB=−3.

For x=−43, we get −2(−43)2+19(−43)+30=A(−43+1)(3(−43)+4)+B(−43−2)(3(−43)+4)+C(−43−2)(−43+1)109=109CC=1.

Therefore, −2x2+19x+30(x−2)(x+1)(3x+4)=2x−2−3x+1+13x+4.
